name: CashCowCoin trading proxy sell() burns CCC from the pair and syncs
summary: CashCowCoin's trading proxy sell() swapped the caller's CCC into the CCC/WBNB pair, then had the token burn that CCC from the pair (proxy-only 0xb20a0b6f) and sync, so each sell took WBNB while the CCC reserve stayed flat. With a flash-loaned buy the attacker ran 80 sells and drained the pair's WBNB.
notes: The token's burn 0xb20a0b6f is gated on mapping slot 29[proxy], set by the owner's 0x497b15d1(proxy) after the implementation upgrade; with it cleared the anchor reverts ("t,a,"), so that grant sets the age. The later Upgraded event at 118208181 re-selected the same implementation and changed no route.

Loss is the pair's WBNB depletion; the attacker's flash-loaned buy returns within the transaction. The pair's CCC is not valued because the drained pair was its market. Only the anchor ever made more than one sell; no copycats.
Implementation and token bytecode are unverified; behaviour is established from the call trace, storage diff and state-override eth_call.
